svg.title: Print operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as print operator, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A broad printing roller feeds a separate sheet bearing two clear printed lines. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
